title: Network Engineer
minimumQualification: Bachelor of Engineering
jobDescription: Job Summary The role will be responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, security, and reliability of LAN, WAN, and wireless networks that support business operations. The ideal candidate should have strong troubleshooting skills, hands-on experience with Cisco networking technologies, and a passion for maintaining stable and secure IT environments. Key Responsibilities • Administer, monitor, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, wireless networks, and related network services. • Configure and troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking issues across the corporate environment. • Support LAN, WAN, WLAN, and internet connectivity services to ensure business continuity. • Implement and maintain routing and switching configurations in accordance with organizational standards. • Monitor network performance, identify bottlenecks, and proactively recommend improvements. • Investigate and resolve network incidents, outages, and service degradation within defined SLAs. • Perform network upgrades, firmware updates, patching, and configuration backups. • Collaborate with internal IT teams, including Service Desk, Systems Administration, Security, and Cloud Infrastructure teams. • Participate in infrastructure projects, network expansion activities, and technology refresh programs. • Ensure compliance with organizational policies, security standards, and audit requirements. Required Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, or a related discipline. • 3 years of experience in network administration, network operations, or network engineering. • Hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches. Technical Skills Routing • Static Routing • OSPF • EIGRP • Basic BGP Concepts • Route Redistribution • Route Summarization Switching • VLANs • Trunking • STP/RSTP • Inter-VLAN Routing • Ether Channel • Switch Stack Management Network Fundamentals • TCP/IP • DNS • DHCP • NAT • ARP • ICMP • SNMP • NTP Preferred Qualifications • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA). • Exposure to network security technologies, including firewalls and VPNs. • Experience with wireless networking solutions. • Familiarity with cloud networking concepts (Microsoft Azure and/or AWS). • Exposure to ITIL-based service management environments. Certification: CCNA Preferred (Good to Have)

title: AI Experience Strategist_Q227
minimumQualification: Bachelor of Design, Bachelor of Engineering
jobDescription:
1. Experience Strategy & Transformation • Define CX vision, north-star, experience principles, and strategic roadmaps for AI-enabled products and services. • Identify high-impact opportunities across journeys, operations, and AI-led transformation. • Lead journey mapping, service design, and future-state experience definition to unlock value. • Establish experience governance frameworks that support responsible, scalable, and measurable AI adoption.
2. Business Value & Impact • Build data-backed business cases with clear ROI, adoption, trust, efficiency, and value-realization measures. • Define success metrics across CX, task completion, containment, fallback performance, adoption, revenue impact, and operational efficiency. • Align AI experience strategy with business, product, technology, risk, and financial goals. • Translate AI capabilities into practical user outcomes, prioritised use cases, and transformation roadmaps.
3. AI-led Innovation • Identify and frame AI-driven experience opportunities across Generative AI, conversational AI, copilots, automation, and agentic workflows. • Conduct AI capability mapping to determine where AI can assist, augment, automate, or escalate user tasks. • Create advanced personas, mental models, behavioral models, and AI interaction scenarios. • Design dynamic information architecture, dialogue flows, multi-turn interaction models, and generative interface patterns. • Develop prompting frameworks, prompt libraries, and reusable Gen AI interaction patterns. • Define containment strategies, fallback mechanisms, escalation pathways, and human handoff experiences. • Design agentic function schemas and collaborate with engineering teams on function-calling workflows for AI assistants and autonomous agents. • Conduct simulations, hallucination audits, AI behavior assessments, and usability testing for AI-generated outputs. • Define LLM evaluation datasets, benchmarks, and quality criteria to assess accuracy, relevance, safety, and user trust. • Partner with data and engineering teams to shape AI-enabled solutions that are usable, accessible, responsible, and business-aligned.
4. Business Development & Thought Leadership • Contribute to proposals, strategic pitches, AI innovation workshops, and client discovery engagements. • Represent design in client discussions and industry forums with a strong point of view on human-centered AI.

minimumQualification: Bachelor of Engineering
jobDescription: Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, integration, and support of ADMS capabilities aligned to electric utility operational needs. Serve as the subject matter expert across SCADA, DMS, OMS, GIS, and EMS workflows, ensuring consistent operational processes and system interoperability. Define functional and technical requirements, use cases, and operating procedures for real-time distribution operations and control room functions. Drive integration design between ADMS and upstream/downstream systems (SCADA/EMS, OMS, GIS), including data models, interfaces, and event/telemetry flows. Ensure grid reliability and operational efficiency by optimizing alarms, events, switching, tagging, and outage/restoration processes across platforms. Lead system configuration, validation, and commissioning activities; support go-live readiness, cutover planning, and hypercare stabilization. Coordinate testing strategy and execution (SIT/UAT), including scenario-based operational testing for outages, switching, and abnormal grid conditions. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective/preventive actions to improve system stability and performance. Collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize enhancements, manage change requests, and ensure solutions align with digital transformation roadmaps. Provide technical leadership and mentorship, guiding cross-functional teams and vendors to deliver high-quality outcomes on schedule. Strong functional and integration experience across DMS, OMS, and GIS, including alignment of network model, outage model, and operational processes. Experience designing and implementing ADMS integrations, including interface specifications, data mapping, and operational validation of end-to-end flows. Demonstrated leadership as an SME/lead on utility transformation programs focused on reliability, efficiency, and modernization outcomes. Expertise in operational testing methodologies, scenario design, and control-room readiness for ADMS/SCADA/OMS deployments. Ability to define and improve KPIs and operational performance measures (e.g., restoration efficiency, alarm quality, situational awareness). Experience working with vendor platforms and coordinating multi-team delivery across IT/OT boundaries. Integration architecture, API/Web services, Data modeling, SQL, ITIL/Incident management. About the Job: Join a team shaping the future of electric utility operations through modern, resilient, and data-driven grid control. In this role, you’ll act as an SME and lead partner to operations, engineering, and IT teams to design, implement, integrate, and support Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) solutions. You’ll work across SCADA, DMS, OMS, GIS, and EMS ecosystems to improve grid reliability, accelerate restoration, and enable digital transformation initiatives. If you enjoy solving complex operational challenges, translating utility needs into scalable system capabilities, and guiding stakeholders through change, you’ll find this role both impactful and rewarding. You’ll help deliver measurable outcomes—safer operations, improved situational awareness, and higher efficiency—while fostering a collaborative culture that values ownership, continuous improvement, and practical innovation. About Us: Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in more than 50 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.\n Infosys provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity; sexual orientation, religious practices and observances; national origin; pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; status as a protected veteran or spouse/family member of a protected veteran; or disability.

5. Leverage and apply optimization techniques (analytics, AI/ML, scenario planning) to improve retail operations, measure, and report on KPIs and deliver value

1. MBA from Tier 1 or Tier 2 B-school with minimum 5+ years of experience in Retail Industry or Bachelor of Engineering from top Universities with minimum of 7 years of experience in Retail Operations.
2. Experience in one or more of the specified areas of Retail consulting/ running business functions or equivalent experience in Brick & Mortar, Omnichannel or ecommerce in Retail space
3. Certification: Specialization in Retail Operations, Point of Sale, store back-office systems, ERP, Buying & Merchandizing or Store Management is an added advantage
5. Comfortable working with complex stakeholders set up – Business Leads, Business SME, IT Teams, Testing, Architects and Market Teams
7. Knowledge of Optimization techniques, applying AI/ML, Automation or advanced analytics for smarter operations and productivity improvements is a plus Good communication skills and comfortable presenting to stakeholders at various organizational levels both in person and remotely. Leadership skills are a plus Knowledge of IT, Solutions-oriented approach, and entrepreneurial mindset

Knowledge of Retail enterprise platforms (ERP like Oracle, SAP, POS systems, OMS platforms like Sterling Commerce, Hybris etc. Merchandizing & Financial Planning, Assortment planning tools, Planograming tools, Inventory management tools) is a big plus As an expert in one or more Retail domain areas, you would be responsible for managing and leading client projects on behalf of Infosys consulting helping them analyze various problems in the Retail domain area, define vision/strategy, possible solutions and work with the larger technology organization to drive use case realization
